results.title: Marcopolo Adventure Yachts at Cannes 2026 | Yachting News
results.author: Alessandro Giuzio
highlights:
# Marcopolo Adventure Yachts debuts at Cannes with MP12 and MP10
...
- Alessandro Giuzio
- August 7, 2026
...
Following its international debut at Boot Düsseldorf 2026, Marcopolo Adventure Yachts continues its growth path with its first participation in the Cannes Yachting Festival 2026. The brand will be present in the Port Canto area with two exhibition spaces: stand POWER 125 inside the covered structure, and stand POWER 007 dedicated to the boats in the water. The new brand from Gruppo Aschenez will present its current lineup to an international audience, featuring the MP12 and MP10 models—two vessels that interpret the adventure yacht concept through a balance of design, technology, and ultimate versatility.
...
Participating in the Cannes Yachting Festival marks an important milestone in the new brand’s international establishment. Following the French show, it will continue its exhibition tour at the 66th Genoa International Boat Show. These two strategic events will allow Marcopolo Adventure Yachts to present its design philosophy to a global audience of boat owners, industry professionals, and trade operators.
...
With its debut at the Cannes Yachting Festival, Marcopolo Adventure Yachts confirms its ambitions in the adventure yacht segment. The combination of Italian design, modularity, innovative materials, and advanced construction technologies yields a lineup crafted for buyers who view boating as an experience of exploration and freedom. The MP12 and MP10 represent two interpretations of the same philosophy, united by their ability to adapt to the owner’s needs and evolve over time—offering a fresh perspective in one of the market’s most dynamic segments.
